changedBehavior: Speed test page groups Test, Live measurement and Results cards; gauges use a unit-labeled 1 Mbps-10 Gbps logarithmic scale with a red-yellow-green speed-quality gradient, neutral needle and fixed FCC-based Slow/Fair/Good ratings on gauge and result values, with system colors in high contrast. A UI-review-only bridge fixture covers provisional, cancelled, failed and final states without internet traffic.
expectedAssertions: Values map to the 1 Mbps-10 Gbps logarithmic arc, pinning below 1 Mbps and above 10 Gbps while numbers stay exact.
Ratings use exact boundaries: download 25 and 100 Mbps, upload 5 and 20 Mbps, applied to the displayed two-decimal value.
The gradient's yellow midpoint lies between each direction's Slow and Good thresholds.
The page contains only the header and the Test, Live measurement and Results cards in order, with controls and gauges in their cards.
After per-run confirmation, provisional gauges expose rated accessible names, Cancel is keyboard reachable and cancellation clears them.
Failed runs show their error without a Results card; final results expose Slow/Fair/Good in accessible names in light, dark and high contrast.
Narrow windows stack the gauges without horizontal clipping of controls, gauges or results.
Existing bridge parser, session state and speed-test host tests remain unchanged and green.
